tooltips.oAuthAccount: Link a Google Gmail OAuth Account. Prefer the side-panel Connect Gmail button — it creates the OAuthAccount and runs consent for you. IMAP/SMTP then use XOAUTH2 (no app password).

messages.gmailOAuthConnected: Gmail connected. Hosts were set to Gmail defaults. Use Test Connection / Send Test Email to verify.
messages.gmailOAuthDisconnected: Gmail disconnected from this Email Account.
messages.gmailConnectHelp: Connect this mailbox with Google. Creates an OAuth account in the background and opens Google sign-in — no app password needed.
messages.gmailLinkedButDisconnected: An OAuth account is linked but has no access token. Click Reconnect to authorize Google again.
messages.gmailSaveBeforeConnect: Save the Email Account first, then connect Gmail.
messages.gmailProviderMissing: Google Gmail OAuth provider was not found. Run rebuild and configure Client ID/Secret under Administration → OAuth Providers.
messages.gmailProviderNotConfigured: Google Gmail OAuth provider is not configured (missing Client ID / secret). Ask an admin to set it under OAuth Providers.
messages.gmailPopupBlocked: Could not open the Google sign-in window. Allow popups for this site and try again.
